title: BrainSiphon domain-expert review records
description: content/reviews.json maps a blueprint slug to the independent review it received. A review that is past validUntil stops counting.

qualifications.description: Professional qualification, registration or role that makes this person competent to review this domain

validUntil.description: Review expiry. Recommended: 12 months, or sooner when a regulation or the model changes

scope.description: Exactly what was reviewed: business assumptions, data assumptions, model selection, thresholds, operational risks. Anything outside is unreviewed

findings.description: Findings raised and their disposition (link to issues)
